rationale.A: Vantaa river paths, then ~1.9 km in mixed traffic incl. 1.2 km on Sörnäisten rantatie (40–50 km/h); 14 lights
rationale.B: ~1.9 km in traffic on Oulunkyläntie, Pohjolankatu (650 m tram) and Otto Brandtin tie; 4 lights
rationale.C: Only 340 m on Otto Brandtin tie, rest on paths beside Oulunkyläntie/Koskelantie/Ratapihantie; unsignalised crossings; 4 lights
rationale.D: No mixed traffic; paths beside Oulunkyläntie, Käpyläntie, Koskelantie, then Eläintarha/Kaisaniemi; 4 lights
rationale.E: No mixed traffic; Vantaa river and Arabia paths, Kalasatama, Merihaansilta; least roadside riding; 7 lights; +3 min
rationale.F: Same as D, with quiet Väinölänkatu in place of the Koskelantie path; 2 lights; +3 min
rationale.G: ~3.3 km beside Hämeentie with several unsignalised Hämeentie crossings; 13 lights
rationale.H: No traffic; Mäkitorpantie path, Käpylä station path, Linnunlaulu; 2 lights; +7 min

notes: F saves 12 lights for 3 min. E is the calmest at +3 min and removes A's long Sörnäisten rantatie traffic stretch. The fastest route is unusually bad here.
